sloka: धर्माद्राज्यं धनं सौख्यमधर्माद्दुःखमेव च ।तस्माद्धर्मं सुखार्थाय कुर्यात्पापं विसर्जयेत् ।। ७.१५.२३ ॥
transliteration: dharmādrājyaṁ dhanaṁ saukhyamadharmādduḥkhameva ca ।tasmāddharmaṁ sukhārthāya kuryātpāpaṁ visarjayet ।। 7.15.23 ॥

translations.english: From righteousness come kingdom, wealth, and happiness, while from unrighteousness comes only sorrow; therefore, one should practice righteousness for the sake of happiness and abandon sin.
